* Detail oriented and excellent analytical skills.
* Ability to work independently and be self motivated.

**Position**: Laboratory Technician

**Who We Are**

AQUA-Science is an ELAP-certified aquatic toxicity testing laboratory located in Davis, California, and an MLJ Environmental company. Established in 1985, we have completed well over 8,000 toxicity tests using freshwater, estuarine, and marine organisms for NPDES compliance, stormwater, agricultural discharge, groundwater, and industrial discharge monitoring. We are a small laboratory with a focus on quality, and we have built a reputation as dependable, unbiased, and thorough experts.

AQUA-Science is seeking a full-time Laboratory Technician. This position conducts aquatic toxicity tests with a variety of aquatic organisms, including fish, invertebrates, plants, and algae. Working under the direct supervision of a Scientist or the Laboratory Supervisor, the Laboratory Technician prepares test solutions, performs water chemistry analyses, measures organism health, and makes sure test data are accurate and complete.

**Schedule and Salary**

This is a full-time, on-site position at our Davis laboratory (40 hours per week). The schedule is Tuesday through Saturday, 8:30 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. The hourly wage is $22 - $28 per hour based on experience. Benefits include health, dental, vision and retirement benefits (401k and profit-sharing).

**Required Skills/Qualifications**:

* B.S. in environmental toxicology, biology, or a related field.
* Ability to work under the direct supervision of a Scientist or Laboratory Supervisor.
* Working knowledge of basic scientific methods.
* Highly motivated and organized, with the ability to work well under pressure.
* Ability to use analytical instruments, scales, calculators, and all other commonly used laboratory equipment.
* Ability to work independently as well as within a team.
* Ability to follow written and verbal instructions.

**Job Duties**:

As a Laboratory Technician, you will conduct aquatic toxicity tests with a variety of aquatic organisms, including fish, invertebrates, plants, and algae. You will make dilutions of test solutions and perform water chemistry analyses for pH, dissolved oxygen, conductivity, alkalinity, hardness, ammonia, and other parameters. You will calibrate the analytical instruments used for these analyses and measure aquatic organism health, including survival, reproduction, and growth.

Accurate data is central to our work. You will enter data according to laboratory protocol and check data for correctness and completeness. We are looking for a motivated, organized individual who works well under pressure and is ready to contribute to the continued success of our laboratory.

At Saputo, we bring good to the table by making high-quality products, investing in our people, and supporting communities around the world . As a top 10 global dairy processor, we value contributions that matter and strive to foster an inclusive, growth-driven work environment. Ready to bring your best?

**Position Summary**

The Quality Control Technician’s responsibilities as the subject matter expert of the production shift and actively monitors production areas to inspect product quality, sample and analyze against established specification and controls. Documents and reports any or potential quality deviation, and recommend corrective and preventative actions (CAPA).

  

**Tasks and Responsibilities:**

* Collects samples and perform physical analytical sampling and testing of raw ingredients, packaging materials and finished goods dairy food products in accordance with established guidelines. Ability to apply and interpret results.
* Perform microbiological/bacteriological sampling and testing of dairy food products in accordance with established guidelines. Ability to apply and interpret results.
* Identify and effectively communicate any out-of-specification analytical test results. Follow established notification protocol.
* Routinely collect product samples from production lines as outlined by testing requirements.
* Exceptional organizational skills in order to maintain all QC records and filing.
* Accurately and neatly complete analytical testing documents and enter data into system.
* Ability to prepare various stock solutions used in the laboratory.
* Calibrate and maintain all lab testing equipment.
* Perform environmental control swabbing after clean-up and CIP/SIP. Report any deviations.
* Knowledge of consumer complaint investigation process.
* Support internal and external audits.
* Support mock and product recall program guidelines.
* Prepare and process production records to isolate any out of specification product including any product deviations from standard, on-hold, regulatory holds, etc.
* Prepare and distribute customer certificates of analysis.
* Must be proficient with all quality control functions throughout the facility.
* Must be able to complete, pass and maintain specific State regulatory licensing/certificate requirements (CDFA, DFA Appendix N, Good Laboratory Practices).
* Perform good laboratory housekeeping within established housekeeping guidelines.
* Comply with all Quality Assurance Procedures (QAP’s).
* Comply with federal, state and local dairy food regulations.
* Adhere to the Saputo Code of Ethics and actively apply the Saputo Company Values.
* Work together professionally with co-workers and other department personnel.
Other duties as required by management.  

  

**Job Requirements:**

  

* Associate’s Degree with a concentration in Food or Dairy Science, preferred.
* Previous experience with food quality specifications, physical and analytical testing, process control monitoring and positive release documentation or similar experience with strict adherence to protocol is preferred.
* Advanced quality/food safety training and/or certifications is a plus, but not required.
* An working understanding of food manufacturing acronyms (SQF, QA/QC, CQP, QAP, HACCP, SOP,5S, GMP, etc.)
* Ability to pass and successfully maintain regulatory certification, as required.
* Strong math skills.
* Strong computer and business skills (SAP, Microsoft Office products, email, copy, scanning)
Strong verbal and written communication skills, in English.  

  

**Physical Demands:**

* Ability to work in manufacturing environment which includes but not limited to: noise, changing temperatures (hot, wet, cold, humid), prolonged periods of standing/walking. Bending/stooping/climbing stairs, maneuvering around manufacturing equipment throughout the shift.
* Working with chemicals, wearing personal protective equipment and following approved chemical handling procedures.
* Good visual acuity with the ability to see and differentiate color.
* Sensory health, ability to taste, smell and evaluate odors and flavors.
* Physical lifting up to 50-lbs intermittently throughout shift. Physical lifting up to 50-lbs with assistance.
Shift flexibility. This is a support role for a 24/7 manufacturing facility. Our quality technicians are assigned to a team on shifts, 24/7 operation to support manufacturing. Work days and shifts may change to help cover vacations/absences, during plant downtime or quality related events such as audits.
